entries.german:
Friedrich, des Wipert Sohn, von Tauberbischofsheim (Bischofshein), Kleriker, öffentlicher Notar, transsumiert den Schiedsspruch in Sachen des Zehnten zu Hochhausen (Hochusen) (StAWt-R US 1407 Mai 27) für Abt Johann von Bronnbach (Brunbach).

Laufzeit: 1426 September 16 ("... millesimo quadringentisimo vicesimo sexto, indicione quarta sedecima die mensis Septembris ... in domo habitacionis honorabilis domini Friderici dicti Gaudorn, altariste parochialis ecclesie opidi Werthein")

Vermerke: Auf der Rückseite: "Instrumentum publicum quod continet discordiam sedatam ex parte decimo inter dominos de Rosenburg (!) et conventum"
entries.english:
Friedrich, son of Wipert, of Tauberbischofsheim, a cleric and public notary, makes a transumpt for Abbot Johann of Bronnbach of the arbitration award concerning the tithe at Hochhausen (StAWt-R US, 27 May 1407).

Date: 16 September 1426 (“... in the year one thousand four hundred twenty-six, in the fourth indiction, on the sixteenth day of September ... in the dwelling house of the honorable lord Friedrich called Gaudorn, altarist of the parish church of the town of Wertheim”).

Notes: On the reverse: “Public instrument containing the settlement of the dispute concerning the tithe between the lords of Rosenburg (!) and the convent.”
